purpose: Source-audited reproduction gate for the published two-stage D4 decoder, joining the corrected signal-only flux observation to an action-conditioned second charge measurement and a decoder-visible charge recovery.
epistemic_role: Structural preflight and fixture audit only; not a logical-error-rate, crossing, threshold, noisy-measurement, or fault-tolerance result.

source_basis.primary: Jing et al. (2025), Appendix A and Appendix C: first fusion-charge observation conditions the flux correction; after a homologically trivial physical/correction Boolean union, a second simultaneous charge record is generated and decoded by the common charge stage.

scientific_question: Does the current executable pipeline preserve the published causal and public-information boundary from corrected signal-only flux decoding through action-conditioned charge recovery before any finite-size sampling is released?

frozen_model.physical_channel: Paper-normalized periodic coloured honeycomb; IID red-X edge errors with p_Z=0. Physical winding is retained as an unconditional terminal logical loss.
observation_timing: Sample the first public flux syndrome and binary colour-resolved e_B/e_G signal from the physical error.
Choose a public flux correction from that first record.
Form the hidden Boolean physical/correction union and terminate if it winds.
Generate the second full binary charge record conditional on the actual first action.
Choose the common blue/green charge correction from the public second record and score it against hidden truth.

decoder_visible_information.first_stage: Flux syndrome plus full binary signal-only e_B/e_G field; zero does not reveal whether degree-two fusion occurred.
decoder_visible_information.second_stage: Known first correction plus one full binary charge value on every star. Hidden active support, relation partition, physical error, effective error representative, and winding truth are forbidden decoder inputs.
decoder_visible_information.private_simulator_truth: Physical error, Boolean union, action-conditioned relation graph, active support, effective charge chain, and homology labels may be used only to generate records and score actions.

flux_policies.O0: Unit-weight MWPM from flux syndrome only.
flux_policies.O2: Published herald-weight MWPM with w_e=1-n_e K and K=27 L^2 from the corrected signal-only first record.
flux_policies.scope: O0 and O2 are the primary source-reproduction arms. Corrected signal-only BP is deferred until this public two-stage interface passes.

frozen_model.common_charge_stage: The same deterministic unit-weight blue/green charge decoder and tie convention are used in both O0 and O2 arms. Its action may depend only on the full public second charge record and known first correction.
frozen_model.logical_scorer: One unconditional attempted-history loss: physical winding OR first-stage Boolean physical/correction-union winding OR blue charge residual winding OR green charge residual winding.
frozen_model.matched_randomness: Each paired trajectory shares the physical-error draw, first-observation exogenous key, and second-measurement exogenous key. The second record is generated separately under each arm's first action; it is not forced to be numerically identical across arms.
frozen_model.uncertainty: No uncertainty interval is computed in preflight. A released pilot must report paired risk differences with a paired bootstrap or paired-binomial interval and Wilson intervals for each unconditional arm risk.
frozen_model.interpretation: No crossing or threshold fit is permitted in this gate or its first finite-size pilot.

preflight_fixture_matrix: zero physical error in both O0 and O2
a frozen L=2 nonwinding physical error with identical first record but different O0/O2 first corrections
corrected first record contains only public binary signals and demonstrates an ambiguous zero
same second-round exogenous key is bound separately to each action-conditioned relation support
each generated second record satisfies its own hidden parity support
public second record is full binary with no inactive sentinel
charge-decoder action is unchanged when hidden relation metadata varies at fixed public record and known first action
Boolean-union terminal scoring and final Boolean-union loss are explicit

compute_budget.release_rule: Allocate no finite-size histories until every structural and public-information gate passes and the manifest is amended with a bounded paired pilot grid.
compute_budget.stop_rule: On the first public-information, causal-order, support, scorer, or prerequisite failure, preserve the witness, mark preflight failed, and register the smallest interface correction.

prohibited: compare Lab 003 q=3/4 numerically with D4
condition the charge action on hidden active support or relation components
force identical second observations after different first actions

preflight_outcome.passing_boundary: Corrected signal-only first record, ambiguous-zero fixture, matched first history, action-dependent second support under a shared exogenous key, own-support validity, zero-error fixture, full-binary public second record, relation-free charge action, wrong-action support rejection, explicit public transcript, and Boolean-union scoring all pass.
remediation_history: The initial preflight failed before sampling because the integrated record used inactive -1 sentinels and the charge action accepted hidden relations.

The pipeline now projects simulator sentinels to a full binary public record, computes both charge corrections through decode_public_postflux_charges(honeycomb, public_charge_outcomes), and passes hidden relations only to the private support validator and scorer.

pilot_registration.epistemic_role: Small paired implementation-and-direction pilot for the complete two-stage public decoder; not a threshold, crossing, scaling, fault-tolerance, or publication-precision study.
pilot_registration.research_question: On the smallest two-size, two-rate paper-channel grid, does the complete public O2 policy lower unconditional final logical loss relative to O0 when both arms use matched histories and the same public charge decoder?

knowledge_states.improvement: O2-minus-O0 paired loss difference is negative; call it resolved in one cell only when the upper 90% paired interval is below zero.
knowledge_states.no_resolved_difference: The paired interval contains zero; retain the information-advantage hypothesis as unresolved at pilot precision.
knowledge_states.regression: The lower 90% paired interval is above zero; report a localized complete-pipeline O2 regression without changing the channel or scorer.
knowledge_states.censored: Any replay, public-information, support, scorer, or completeness gate fails; preserve the witness and release no decoder comparison.

grid.rationale: L=3 is the smallest nontrivial post-flux charge topology and L=5 is the smallest R6AE production size; p_X=0.19 and 0.21 reuse the validated paper-region channel on opposite sides of the quoted neighborhood without estimating a crossing.

pilot_registration.independent_sampling_unit: One physical red-X history at fixed (L,p_X), paired across O0 and O2. Arms within a history are dependent and must never be treated as independent rows.

seed_contract.matching_rule: Both arms consume the identical physical history and first public record. Both receive the identical second exogenous key, but each second record is generated against its own first-action-conditioned hidden support and therefore need not be numerically equal.

policies.O0: Unit-weight flux MWPM followed, when nonterminal, by the common relation-free public blue/green unit-weight charge MWPM.
policies.O2: Published signal-only herald-weight flux MWPM with K=27L^2 followed, when nonterminal, by the identical public blue/green charge MWPM.
policies.one_changed_mechanism: Only the first-stage flux weights differ between arms. Physical channel, observation timing, random keys, second-stage implementation, and scorer are fixed.

observable.primary: Per-cell paired difference Delta=R_O2-R_O0 in unconditional final Boolean-union logical loss.
observable.arm_risks: Per-cell unconditional attempted-history logical-loss risk for O0 and O2.
observable.stage_decomposition: Matched counts of physical-winding terminal loss, first-union terminal loss, charge-stage loss, and decoded success; decomposition is diagnostic and does not change the primary score.
observable.denominator: Every attempted physical history, including terminal physical winding and first-union winding.

uncertainty_and_analysis.arm_intervals: Pointwise two-sided 90% Wilson intervals per arm and cell.
uncertainty_and_analysis.paired_interval: Pointwise two-sided 90% percentile bootstrap interval for Delta, resampling the 512 paired histories within each cell with 10000 deterministic replicates and bootstrap salt 68616.
uncertainty_and_analysis.discordance_diagnostic: Report O0-only and O2-only logical losses and a two-sided exact McNemar/binomial p-value on discordant pairs; do not use it as a multiple-cell discovery claim.
uncertainty_and_analysis.multiplicity: All four cells are pilot diagnostics; no family-wise scientific claim is registered. Any across-grid pattern is descriptive only.
uncertainty_and_analysis.finite_size_rule: Do not interpolate, fit, bracket, or estimate a crossing or threshold. Do not compare risks numerically with Lab 003.

verification_and_acceptance: Runner refuses execution unless the R6AF preflight result is passed with no failed gates and pilot_registration_authorized=true.
All 2048 independent histories and 4096 arm evaluations complete or the checkpoint records the exact failed cell and trajectory.
Every paired arm has identical physical error, first flux syndrome, first binary signal record, and registered physical/first/second exogenous keys.
Every nonterminal second record is full binary, satisfies its own action-conditioned hidden support, and is decoded through decode_public_postflux_charges without hidden relation inputs.
Replaying a frozen first, middle, and final trajectory in every cell reproduces both public transcripts, actions, stage status, and final loss exactly.
Each final loss equals physical winding OR first Boolean-union winding OR blue charge winding OR green charge winding, with every attempted history retained in the denominator.
Report point estimates, registered uncertainty, discordances, stage counts, timing, and any censored records before interpreting direction.

compute_budget.no_adaptive_extension: Stop at 512 histories/cell even if every paired interval is unresolved. Any extension, new size, or new p_X requires a new registered transition.

stop_rules: Stop before sampling if source/preflight hashes or public-interface tests fail.

Stop and preserve the checkpoint on any paired-input mismatch, nonbinary public record, wrong-support acceptance, private-field transcript leak, support violation, scorer mismatch, nonfinite weight, or replay failure.
Stop after the complete four-cell pilot, analysis, report, and metadata update; do not launch refinement or threshold sampling in the same transition.
claims_prohibited: claim that unresolved pilot intervals prove equality
adaptive sample enlargement without a new manifest amendment

pilot_outcome.mechanism_boundary: The pilot advantage is dominated by fewer first-stage Boolean-union failures under O2; both arms use the identical relation-free public charge decoder. Stage decomposition is diagnostic, not a separately randomized causal estimand.
pilot_outcome.claim_boundary: Pointwise complete-pipeline pilot evidence only; no threshold, crossing, scaling, fault-tolerance, BP, Lab 003 comparison, or multiplicity-adjusted discovery claim.

next_action: Register a bounded source-consistency synthesis comparing this complete-pipeline pilot's direction and stage decomposition with the exact primitive R4.5c policy audit before deciding whether a larger public-decoder validation is warranted; do not extend this pilot.
